summary: Today brings a mixed briefing led by key regulatory updates in consumer compliance alongside significant retail sector performance metrics. Primary drivers include expanded mandatory gold hallmarking rules across 398 districts and Reliance's major ₹1 lakh crore investment pledge in Andhra Pradesh.

bullets.text: Reliance announced plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh to establish biogas plants, creating an estimated 3 lakh job opportunities.
The Consumer Affairs Ministry notified the Fourth Amendment to Gold Hallmarking Order, expanding mandatory district coverage to 398 across 26 States and UTs.
Procter & Gamble Hygiene reported a 6.7% YoY decline in Q2 net profit to Rs 196 crore due to elevated raw material costs.
DIFC Court rejected Persephone’s appeal against setting aside a USD 18.4 million arbitral award in its commercial dispute with Princeton.
ITC Foods' senior nutrition brand Right Shift achieved 300% growth, planning quarterly product launches to expand its portfolio.
